description: This Java class models a Payment entity with properties such as payment type, transaction type, module name, and currency, providing getter and setter methods for each field.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: A model class representing a payment with associated details like payment type, transaction type, module name, and currency.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for this payment.

methods.name: setTransactionType
methods.description: Sets the transaction type; defaults to AUTHORECAPTURE.

methods.name: setModuleName
methods.description: Sets the module name associated with this payment.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency associated with this payment.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for this payment.
